description: This Java class is a builder for creating ImmutableFeatures objects, providing a fluent API for setting, retrieving, and removing features, and implementing the FeaturesBuilder interface.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableFeatures objects in a fluent manner, supporting operations like setting, getting, removing features, and building the final ImmutableFeatures instance.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableFeaturesBuilder with an empty features map.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a feature in the builder, replacing any existing feature with the same ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the feature with the specified ID, if present.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple features from an iterable collection into the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified feature from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a feature based on its ID.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Clears all features from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an ImmutableFeatures object from the current features in the builder.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the features in the builder.
